Measurements, with perspective.

A photograph is a starting point, not a verdict. Camera distance, expression, head angle, and light all change the measurements.

How does the analysis work?

Google MediaPipe locates facial landmarks on your image. Forma measures distances and angles in the image plane, correcting for image dimensions and head roll. It cannot recover true bone structure, a side profile, or physical dimensions from one photo. Read about MediaPipe.

What do PSL, MTN, and HTN mean?

These are informal online appearance labels. MTN means “mid-tier normie” and HTN means “high-tier normie.” There is no agreed, validated mapping or objective attractiveness test. Forma's optional estimate is an openly defined geometry heuristic for entertainment; it is not a percentile or a prediction of how people will see you.

What happens to my photo?

Photos and measurements stay in this page's memory. No photo is uploaded or saved by Forma. Reloading clears the session. Exported reports and images are saved only when you choose to download them.
